description: Recipe for the creator's two-Spark MiniMax H3 stack (knapcio/MiniMax-H3-2x-DGX-Spark-TP2 at 2845006): vLLM-Omni v0.30.0 with the text encoder tensor-parallel and the DiT Ulysses sequence-parallel over two Sparks, online FP8 DiT, 1344x768 and 20 steps by default. One job renders one 4 to 15 second clip with synchronized audio from a prompt, optionally from a first and/or last keyframe; every job pays the model load.

flow-shift.description: Noise schedule shift; the creator's default is 12. Any positive number is accepted.
flow-shift.label: Flow shift

num-inference-steps.description: More steps refine the video and take longer. The creator's example uses 20.
num-inference-steps.label: Denoising steps

seed.description: Random seed; the same seed and options give the same video.
seed.label: Seed

title: MiniMax H3 FL2VA two-Spark vLLM-Omni (knapcio)
